title: Bus arrival forecasting from live GPS feeds
description: Ingested a year of city transit pings, rebuilt each trip's progress along its route, and predicted arrival time at the next four stops. Gradient boosting on trip-so-far features beat the agency's static timetable, especially in the evening peak.
result: Mean absolute error 2.4 min, down from 5.1

title: Coral bleaching detection in satellite tiles
description: Fine-tuned a small ResNet on Sentinel-2 reef imagery with a reviewed label set of 3,800 tiles. Cloud and sun-glint tiles were the main failure mode, so I added a masking step before inference and reported per-reef accuracy rather than a single global score.

title: Campus energy anomaly monitor
description: Half-hourly meter readings from 14 buildings, decomposed into seasonal and residual components, with residuals scored for outliers. Facilities now get a Monday digest; the first month surfaced a chiller running through two semester breaks.

title: Search across four semesters of lecture notes
description: A weekend project that stuck. Notes and slide text are chunked, embedded and served through a small local API, so I can ask a question in plain language and get the three passages that answer it. Evaluated against 120 questions I wrote myself.
